conf.description: ArcSight Connectors arcmc-audit, avro-kafka: Avro decode happens at the Kafka+Schema-Registry Source (not a whitelisted pipeline function), so this pipeline starts from already-flat canonical CEF field names. Derives event.outcome from deviceEventCategory's /Success//Fail suffix per recommendations.direct.cribl's own words ("the cleanest input"), event.kind=metric on the cpu:/disk:/hardware:/raid: health families, and resolves the deviceCustomString1..6 Label-keyed health slots generically (no per-signature label vocabulary is documented for this dataset, unlike connector-audit's agent:049).

conf.comment: arcsight-connectors / arcmc-audit / avro-kafka. No Avro/Schema-Registry decode function exists in the whitelist - that happens at the Kafka Source, same convention as this technology's device-status and connector-audit avro-kafka pipelines. event.outcome is derived from deviceEventCategory's documented /Success and /Fail suffixes (recommendation's own 'cleanest input'), NOT from a per-family numeric-code lookup - no exhaustive code table is given across the connector:/arcmc:/platform:/health families, and inventing one would guess. deviceSeverity is left as a raw 0-10 copy: no platform-numeric lookup table is supplied. deviceCustomString1..6/Label pairs are preserved generically (label+value pairs) since no per-signature label vocabulary is documented here.
